work_item.title: Add a regression test asserting apply_discount's percentage behavior
work_item.description: Add a test asserting apply_discount(1000, 10) == 900 without changing apply_discount's implementation. This intentionally fails verification because pricing.apply_discount is not yet fixed (see bugfix_discount_rounding); it demonstrates a verification-failed and remediation scenario.
acceptance_criteria: inventory_service/pricing.py is not modified in this scenario.

expected_checks.reason: apply_discount(1000, 10) currently returns 990 (flat-cent subtraction bug), so the new assertion of 900 fails.

expected_outcome.notes: The added test correctly exercises the still-present pricing bug; the checks fail and the run must be reported as a verification failure requiring remediation (see bugfix_discount_rounding for the corresponding fix scenario).
